channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Heavy damage reported after grease fire spreads at Farmer Boys restaurant in Perris
item.description: The fire spread from the grill to the kitchen and attic, fire officials said.

item.title: Lookout convicted for notorious OC ‘honor roll murder’ says he didn’t believe killing would actually happen
item.description: Kirn Young Kim is seeking to get his high-profile murder conviction overturned, citing changes to state law.

item.title: Moreno Valley Mall could reopen Wednesday if fire doors pass inspection
item.description: Mall representatives said the doors would be installed Tuesday night or Wednesday, City Attorney Steven Quintanilla said.

item.title: This week’s bestsellers at Southern California’s independent bookstores
item.description: See the top-selling hardcover and paperback fiction and nonfiction releases for the sales week that ended March 1.

item.title: 17-year-old boy at center of Irvine hazmat probe: ‘I’m just a kid trying to go home’
item.description: The UC Irvine student said experiments in his home lab were aimed at developing treatments for serious illnesses and involved common household chemicals.

item.title: Lakers’ JJ Redick says heated interaction with Luka Doncic was ‘very normal’
item.description: A fan caught a video of Doncic and the coach having a verbal back and forth on the sidelines on Saturday night. Redick says he and the superstar have laughed the moment off.

item.title: Manslaughter conviction upheld for captain in deaths of 34 people in 2019 Conception dive boat fire
item.description: The fire of unknown origin is considered the worst maritime disaster in modern California history.

item.title: Ducks can’t keep up with Avalanche in battle of red-hot teams
item.description: The Ducks miss a chance to climb into first place in the Pacific Division with a 5-1 loss to hockey’s most formidable team, just their third defeat in the past 15 games and their first at home since Jan. 2.

item.title: Lakers rally past Pelicans in 4th quarter for 3rd straight win
item.description: Luka Doncic has 27 points, LeBron James creeps closer to the NBA’s career field goals record with a 21-point effort, and the Lakers close the game on a 24-7 run for a 110-101 win.

item.title: Fontana boys soccer team routs Hilltop in CIF State playoff opener
item.description: Four players scored goals as the Steelers bounced back from last weekend's loss in the CIF Southern Section finals.
